summary: ADR0096 section C records one Root-reviewed finite envelope binding exact source, inputs, resources, ordered actions and write domains. Verified success permits conditional advance without repeated step approvals, while each step retains its original clock and independent readback. Stop on failure, Unknown, determining-input drift or budget exhaustion; no automatic retry, clock renewal or new-ID replay. Only reviewed derivations from closed verified outputs can supply later inputs. Prove actual engine graphroot/runroot/temp/output/process isolation, preserving old holds and original outcomes separately from current metadata. Early real credential/policy/workflow/runtime preflight and typed observations remain substantive. Runner, bake, registration and first consumer retain priority; reusable builder/desktop facility preparation and source-bound handoff are not native qualification. Source packaging and installed instruction adoption remain separate delivery claims.
title: Finite delegated execution requires demonstrated isolation
